name: Furious Football: Demons vs Humans
source:
You have been summoned to another world because you are the greatest football player!
Only you can save the human kingdom from the demons!
Three opponents await you!
You must defeat them in a game of football!
translation:
因为你是世上最伟大的足球运动员，异世界向你发出了召唤！
唯有你能从恶魔手中拯救人类王国！
三名强敌正等待着你的挑战！
你必须在绿茵场上用足球击败她们！
